rules.observationReference: Observation.geographyId must reference a canonical geography key; free-text geography names are not accepted.
rules.countyKey: Use the existing KPCG canonical county slug for ADM1 observations and relationships.
rules.subcountyWardKey: Use the supplied administrative geometry shape ID for ADM2 and ADM3 until a formally approved national code crosswalk is loaded.
rules.geometryAuthority: Use the user-supplied/checksum-pinned geoBoundaries Kenya ADM0-ADM3 evidence set; never fabricate boundaries.
rules.parentAuthority: Use /data/admin/hierarchy-index.json for ADM2→ADM1 and ADM3→ADM2 relationships.
rules.futureCrosswalk: National/county code crosswalks may be added as aliases without changing Observation.geographyId semantics.
